activities.prompt: Which statement best describes an atrophic cell?

options.text: It has enlarged by gaining cell substance
options.evidence: This describes hypertrophy.

options.text: It has increased in number without a size change
options.evidence: This describes hyperplasia.

explanation.en: Atrophy involves loss of cell substance, reduced size and function, with a new equilibrium; the cell is not dead.

activities.prompt: What role does ubiquitin play in protein removal?

options.text: It becomes a permanent part of every degradation product
options.evidence: The diagram shows ubiquitin recycling.

options.text: It permanently prevents proteasomes from recognizing proteins
options.evidence: Tagged proteins are recognized by proteasomes.

options.text: It is the lysosomal hydrolase that digests organelles
options.evidence: Lysosomal hydrolases are a different proteolytic system.

options.text: It tags old or damaged proteins for proteasomal degradation
